optimization.motion_derivative_convention: At a clip boundary use the feasible loss-decreasing side: upper/y<mu and lower/y>mu have derivative1; the opposite side has derivative0. A zero-width speed interval has derivative0. Mixture responsibilities weight these component derivatives. Interior derivatives are ordinary.
